style: Present-day Tamil Dravidian temple on the Swami Rock headland
key_structures: Broad hall and sculpted entrance tower
Red entrance steps and central ramp
Large seated Shiva beside the entrance
Lower Ravana statue and facing Shiva linga
special_features: The headland narrows toward the tip overlooking the sea.
The living temple venerates Koneswarar and Mathumai Amman.
The Shankari tradition is associated with the site; the ancient shrine footprint remains unresolved.
period: Present temple rebuilt in the twentieth century
renovation_history: The older complex was destroyed in the Portuguese period. The modeled compound follows twentieth-century reconstruction and later photographed additions.
